description: Every account the rep (and their team) has logged: where it stands per product segment, the share of a customer's cases held and the room to grow, when it was last touched, and the next follow-up. Filter by status or by days untouched; sort=room puts the customers with the most cases not yet won first. Use it for a pipeline review, a list of neglected accounts, or where to expand.

sort.description: due (default): overdue follow-ups first, then longest untouched. room: most room to grow first.

untouched_days.description: Only accounts with nothing logged in 30, 60 or 90 days.

name: my_accounts
title: The rep's accounts
